text:
Liam (Campus Recruiter): Quick weird one from the on-campus hiring event today :bs — several interviewers on the shared kiosk reported their qualitative notes appearing under the wrong candidate in the ATS. Not sure if drafts are being swapped.

Hannah (People Ops): Yikes. Which candidates/panels? We ran multiple interviews back-to-back on the same machine, so drafts could collide if session cookie persists.

Liam (Campus Recruiter): CAND-10345, CAND-10348, CAND-10351. Two interviewers remembered saving drafts then later saw a different candidate name in the form when they reopened. One even saw someone else's partial comment.

Omar (Eng Infra): That sounds like a session scoping bug. The kiosk uses a short-lived anonymous session tied to the browser cookie. If a new candidate is loaded but cookie wasn't cleared, draft_save may have keyed on cookie+form_id instead of candidate_id. I'll check logs.

Priya (Hiring Manager): This is bad for confidentiality and debrief accuracy. For now pause any hiring decisions for those three candidates until we confirm. Also notify affected interviewers to stop using the kiosk until fixed.

Jo (UX): Was there a recent change to the draft autosave behavior? We rolled a small tweak to try to persist drafts across accidental refreshes which might have changed the keying scope.

Omar (Eng Infra): Found the code change in release notes: "persist draft by session_key + form_id" pushed this morning. That explains it. We should have scoped to candidate_id+form_id instead. Snippet from logs: 
```
INSERT INTO draft_store (key, payload) VALUES ('sess:abcd123|form:scorecard', '{...}')
```
No candidate_id in key.

Hannah (People Ops): Ok immediate mitigation: rollback that tweak or restrict kiosk builds to a version that uses candidate-scoped keys. Also can we add a clear-cookie button on the kiosk home screen so proctors can cycle sessions?

Liam (Campus Recruiter): I'll tell campus proctors to clear cookies between interviews and stop using kiosk until we get a fix. I'll also reach out to the affected interviewers and ask them to paste their notes here if they have copies.

Omar (Eng Infra): Plan: (1) hotfix mapper to resolve ambiguous drafts by matching timestamp + interviewer_id to likely candidate; (2) revert draft persistence tweak for kiosk builds; (3) add server-side validation that draft key must include candidate_id or reject. I will open RECR-4238.

sysbot: RECR-4238 created by Omar: "kiosk draft collision due to session-scoped persistence"

Jo (UX): For longer-term, we should make the kiosk explicit: onboarding screen that forces interviewer to select or scan candidate badge before any draft can be created. That reduces human error. I'll prototype a one-tap scan flow.

Priya (Hiring Manager): Also add a confidentiality note: "Never leave kiosk unattended while signed-in" and make proctors sign-off after each panel. Put this in the campus playbook.

Hannah (People Ops): Assigning actions: Omar  hotfix + rollback + run recovery; Liam  outreach + instruct proctors; Jo  scan flow prototype; Priya  playbook update. I'll coordinate with security on the confidentiality notice.

Liam (Campus Recruiter): Outreach sent to affected interviewers, two responded and pasted their original comments here. I will hold decisions until Omar posts recovery. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
